item.title: Notiqflow 0.4.6
item.description:
Notiqflow 0.4.6

This is an important fix. If dictation stopped working for you on 0.4.3 or later, this release repairs it.

  • The speech model loads again. Since 0.4.3, Notiqflow checked the speech model's files in the wrong folder before loading it. The check always failed, so the model never loaded and dictation was unavailable — reported on screen as "Trusted model file is missing" or, on 0.4.5, "parakeet-v3 couldn't be removed". Nothing was ever wrong with your downloaded model, and this update needs no re-download.
  • Clearer messages if a model really is damaged. Verification failures now name the full location that was checked, instead of just a file name.

Update and dictation works again immediately — no re-download, no re-granting permissions.
